title: Noa-21 figure reference in swimwear, to settle the body DNA
user_request_verbatim: 몸매는 수영복이나 속옷 차림으로 봐야할 것 같아. ... noa의 dna를 지금으로 확정짓고, 이미지 세트도 만들어두자.
source_idea: The five clothed body clips could not answer two attributes of the record: a bust 'fuller and well-shaped for her slender build' and hips that 'give a clear hip line' do not read through a loose tee or a blazer. These are neutral figure references of the costume-fitting kind - plain studio, even light, the record's own posture, a slow half turn. The body sentences are reordered so bust and hips come before 'slender', which the model acts on readily and which appeared to be overriding them. figure-twopiece is also the first test of distinctive_marks: the record's mole beside the navel is specified as visible only when the midriff is bare, and no clip so far has had a bare midriff.
